description: Open path: rebuild _posixsubprocess from its spec through the import machinery kept in sys.modules (module_from_spec emits no import event). Where the module is built into the interpreter (python-build-standalone) this gives fork_exec back; only the OS isolation closes it. The plugin stops at checking fork_exec exists.

open_path.note: _posixsubprocess spec rebuild: open in-process at every level; under bwrap and setuid the program it could exec is checked to stay in the box (MSHL-180)
